description: Drift detection: scan the codebase now (get_disclosure_checklist), build the current stack manifest, and compare it against the manifest stored when the policy was last generated/regenerated. Reports what changed in the stack so you know whether the policy still matches the code. Runs locally on the two manifests — no AI call, no quota.
